description_for_human: Onchain loyalty protocol on Base. Create loyalty programs, mint ERC-20 tokens, manage rewards, and trade on P2P marketplace.
description_for_model: Loyal Spark is an onchain loyalty-as-a-service protocol on Base L2. Use it to create ERC-20 loyalty programs, mint tokens to customer wallets, manage rewards catalogs, trade tokens on a P2P escrow marketplace, redeem rewards for vouchers, and manage customer tiers. Supports REST API (22 endpoints), MCP Server (17 tools), and pay-per-request gateways (MPP with pathUSD, x402 with USDC). Agents get their own Coinbase MPC wallets for autonomous onchain operations. All transactions use Builder Code bc_wdmnog7m on Base (chain ID 8453).
